Competition Day Route Marking: On the day of each competition, the ONLY update made to the card is drawing the specific field entrance route, coordinate placement, prop facing orientation, and exit trajectory arrows directly onto the laminated card using a wet-erase or dry-erase marker. Students are pre-trained on facing symbols.

[word/document.xml] 3. CBA Field Entrance & Exit Routing Rules: Follow all CBA boundary and timing regulations. Enter and exit strictly through designated back sideline or rear end zone gates (above goal posts). NEVER cross, stage, or transit props in the front sideline end zone area below the goal posts (marked with a red 'X'). Maintain continuous egress uphill to the trailer staging lot without de-ballasting at the stadium chute.

[word/document.xml] 4. Two-Shot Staging Protocol: During two-shot competitions (Prelims & Finals), leave sandbag ballast intact on the carts in the trailer lot between shows. If winds increase during the afternoon break, simply remove the quick-release pin from each diagonal strut to lay the vinyl frames flat on the carts, eliminating sail area while maintaining readiness.
+[word/document.xml] APPENDIX D: PARENT VOLUNTEER COMPETITION DAY GUIDE & FIELD PROTOCOL
+[word/document.xml] One-Page Operational Guide & CBA Rules Compliance for Pit Crew & Prop Volunteers
+[word/document.xml] 1. Volunteer Schedule, Staging Milestones & Call Times
+[word/document.xml] Meet trailer, deploy ramps, unstrap cart bases from nose wall.
+[word/document.xml] Bolt frames using cordless power driver; mate struts & pins; stow tennis balls.
+[word/document.xml] Assist front ensemble movement; inspect double-bagged sandbags & chocks.
+[word/document.xml] Pre-stage in rear half of end zone above goal post (Rule 5.03); don wristbands.
+[word/document.xml] Await T&P judge permission; set props; CLEAR FIELD BEFORE ANNOUNCEMENT ENDS!
+[word/document.xml] Continuous egress up hill to trailer lot (Rule 8.05); DO NOT de-ballast at chute!
+[word/document.xml] Leave ballast on carts in lot; if gusts pick up, pull strut pins to lay frames flat.
+[word/document.xml] Don Finals wristbands (new color); await T&P judge; set props; clear field.
+[word/document.xml] Uphill egress to truck; de-ballast; unbolt frames; tennis balls on struts; load trailer.
+[word/document.xml] 2. 2026 CBA Marching Band Rules Governing Adult On-Field Behavior

+[word/document.xml] • Mandatory Field Pass Wristbands (Rule 9.07): Access to the performance field for parents assisting with props or front ensemble equipment is strictly restricted to designated Field Pass wristbands (maximum 25 per band upon check-in; no additional wristbands available). Wristbands permit access ONLY to the Performance Field (not to spectator stands or stadium seating). Sanctioned contests with a prelims/finals format issue distinct, separate colors for Prelims and Finals. Finals wristbands are provided in the director's packet following Prelims awards.

+[word/document.xml] • Field Entry Permission & Pre-Staging (Rule 5.06 & Rule 5.03): NEVER enter the performance field before the Timing & Penalties (T&P) judge gives official permission. Equipment and handlers may pre-stage in the rear half of the end zone (from middle of goal post to far sideline) up to the goal line prior to permission (Rule 5.03). Exiting bands maintain absolute right-of-way through the front half of the end zone. Total field time starts immediately upon entry permission.

+[word/document.xml] • Field Clearance Before Performance (Rule 4.03 & Rule 5.06): All adult volunteers assisting with props or equipment MUST BE COMPLETELY CLEAR of the performance field (including backfield and end zones) before the introductory announcement ends. The announcement commences 3:15 after entry permission; performance begins at announcement conclusion. Any adult still within the performance area when the announcement ends incurs an immediate 0.2 point score penalty for the band.

+[word/document.xml] • Re-Entry Prohibition During Performance (Rule 4.03): Adult volunteers are strictly prohibited from entering or re-entering the performance field during the performance. Unauthorized entry or re-entry incurs an immediate 0.2 point penalty per occurrence (up to 0.4 maximum). Adults must remain in designated exterior perimeter staging areas until all performed sound has ceased.

+[word/document.xml] • Medical Emergency Performer Assistance Exception (Rule 4.02(c)): NO PENALTY. Any band member becoming ill or injured during a performance may be assisted from the field by an adult volunteer, parent, staff member, emergency medical technician, or CBA official without any penalty whatsoever. Performer health, emergency medical response, and safety always supersede boundary rules.

+[word/document.xml] • High-Wind Prop Safety Restraint Exception (Rule 4.02(a)): In the event of high winds when props are in danger of falling over, adults may be in the performance field during a performance for the sole purpose of securing the prop. At no time during the performance may an adult move the prop as part of the visual choreography or show performance.

+[word/document.xml] • Continuous Uphill Egress & Double-Bagging (Rule 8.05): Following the performance, all props and equipment must remain in continuous movement until entirely removed from the stadium. NEVER stop or de-ballast carts at the stadium exit chute or tunnel—maintain momentum up the incline to the trailer staging lot with 3–4 handlers per cart. All sandbags must be double-bagged with intact plastic inner liners to prevent sand spillage on athletic turf.

+[word/document.xml] • Low Base Pushing: Always push strictly from the lower 2x4 wooden cart framing. NEVER push, pull, or climb on the upright steel posts or diagonal struts to prevent bending tubing or distorting bracket alignment.

+[word/document.xml] • Steep Ramps & Wind Sizing: Normal field movement requires a minimum of 2 handlers per cart. Whenever navigating steep stadium inclines (specifically the USAFA Falcon Stadium concrete tunnel entrance ramp) or operating in high winds, assign 3 to 4 handlers per cart to maintain controlled braking and momentum.

+[word/document.xml] • Strut Tennis Balls & Power Driver: Ensure slotted tennis balls are installed over upper strut ends whenever vinyl frames are detached. Use cordless power drivers with socket adapters for frame unbolting and bolting to achieve rapid trailer turnaround.
